confirmedFindings: The reported Safari failure belongs to the server-stopped branch at 127.0.0.1:4178; restarting the target workspace Vite server clears that failure.
The current default runtime keeps NightCityRenderer as the scene owner; a running server alone will not turn ?longmap=1 into a code-drawn ComponentRenderer preview.
The file-launch fallback remains available and is separate from the stopped dev-server route.
remainingGaps: A separate implementation request is required to wire an explicit code-drawn preview route with natural-input evidence.
